excerpt: Asia stock markets showed significant gains, with the Nikkei 225 rising 4.03% and the Hang Seng Index up 0.10%. Key tech stocks like SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also saw substantial increases. Some sectors experienced declines, such as pharmaceuticals and consumer electronics.
